question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN age >= 20 AND age < 30 THEN '20s'
        WHEN age >= 30 AND age < 40 THEN '30s'
        WHEN age >= 40 AND age < 50 THEN '40s'
        WHEN age >= 50 AND age < 60 THEN '50s'
        ELSE 'others'
    END as age_category,
    COUNT(*) as user_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        birth_date,
        CAST((date('2024-01-01') - date(birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) as age
    FROM mst_users
    WHERE birth_date IS NOT NULL
)
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY 
    CASE age_category
        WHEN '20s' THEN 1
        WHEN '30s' THEN 2
        WHEN '40s' THEN 3
        WHEN '50s' THEN 4
        WHEN 'others' THEN 5
    END
